note: Judged 2026-09-30 at the producers after the D-8 fix: wire Transform.AttrsUnderstood (attrFormats, Key Length only); appendIKECombinations and espProposalMatches drop a transform carrying an unknown attribute and keep its siblings, and refuse the proposal only when an offered type loses every transform (IKEProposal.UnacceptableTransformType -> ErrTransformUnacceptable in ikeProposalComplete; ESP offered!=usable). This matches Section 3.3.6: the transform is unacceptable, other transforms of the same type are processed as usual, and a type with nothing acceptable leaves no complete set to select. Negative TestRFC7296UnacceptableTransformAloneRefusesTheProposal: unknown ENCR id alone, and each IKE type (ENCR/PRF/INTEG/D-H) and ESP type (ENCR/INTEG/ESN) carrying attribute 99 alone is refused, with a per-type control without the attribute accepted, so the attribute is the only difference (isolated); this failed before the fix. Positive TestRFC7296UnacceptableTransformLeavesSiblingsOnOffer: the unknown-id and unknown-attribute transform beside an understood sibling, both orders, IKE accepted with the sibling's ENCR and ESP matched (catches an over-reaction that refuses the type or proposal). ESP response is built from config, so no unacceptable attribute is echoed. HEAD crypto/engine tags remain supplementary. Records: appendIKECombinations +, espProposalMatches -, observed red.
